attributes.problem_statement: In 2018 when Ledger Cardano App was developed, there was no standard for embedded app UI. Over the years this changed and now Cardano is the only Ledger application with non-standard UI such as requiring double-click several times during the confirmation process. This is causing confusion among users and problems with testing because the design is not compatible with the testing suite.
attributes.proposal_benefit: Ledger wallet users will have better Cardano experience. Further app updates and releases will be faster and cheaper due to Ledger testing suite compatibility.

From a workshop, the North American Community Hub summarized feedback noting the Ledger App Rewrite’s usability goals but highlighting unclear metrics and Core readiness. Vacuumlabs’ role is promising, but further review is needed. Project Catalyst is recommended to clarify deliverables.
Signed: North American Community Hub

IMO deliverables are very clear
- in cooperation with Ledger define future Cardano Leder app UX/UI to match the standard while considering Cardano differences and non-standard features
- implement it in a way that will make the Cardano Ledger app compatible with Ledger testing suite and other Ledger tooling including new Ledger devices

I wonder if we don't do that, would Ledger eventually integrate with us, because if they don't, they risk losing users who move to other devices?
We have previously also funded near millions to integrate with Ledger updates through Catalyst.
